gen-gf-unica-one-gf-puritan: Puritan reads soft and friendly, its rounded plain sans forms leaving big open e and a counters. If the heading were made small, Unica One would lose its commanding punch, since its single-thickness line only really speaks at size.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-questrial: Stencil-cut and sharp, Unica One lets daylight into every curve, while Questrial stands tall with open c, e and s shapes. Over a long stretch, Questrial's single-weight sans strokes stay smooth and modern.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada's plain sans reads full and tall, with c, s and z standing proud and every curve left open at its end. Unica One is the one that commands; Radio Canada is the one that carries.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-radio-canada-big: A very large lowercase eye gives Unica One its signature, with daylight showing inside every curve. Radio Canada Big then fills the line with a tall x-height and a monoline skeleton, finishing its terminals well clear of the stem.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-readex-pro: Unica One's very large lowercase eye and uniform strokes give it a commanding, distinctive face. And Readex Pro, a sans-serif with broad terminal gaps, works well when it is simply allowed to be larger than you expect.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-roboto: Unica One draws its bowls at stem thickness, a ruler-straight display voice with real command. Roboto, a sans with generous mouths on its round letters, is the one that quietly does the reading.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-ruda: Wire-thin and commanding, Unica One lets light through every curve of its single-thickness line. But Ruda, a sans-serif with a sizable x-height, tends to look best when its size is nudged up a little for screens.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-saira: Sharp corners, no swelling, pure display attitude. Saira's plain sans letters stretch high toward the top line with a visible gap in each s, so a long passage moves along smoothly beneath Unica One.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-radio-canada: Spaghetti-like strokes give Funnel Display an expressive, commanding look. Radio Canada follows with tall, full c, s and z shapes in a plain sans line, keeping the page contemporary and orderly.
gen-flavors-gf-open-sans: Flavors has an x-height towering like a stubby carpenter's pencil. Open Sans, a sans-serif with bulky lowercase proportions and smooth curves, rarely needs its size pushed far beyond the default to hold its own.
